argv: A local FEA handoff data-contract for explicit governed export of geometry, properties, loads, constraints, units, provenance, mappings, and result re-association is produced.

The contract preserves solver-neutral schema and manifest boundaries, stable identifiers, coordinate and unit conventions, provenance and protected/private-data controls, completeness and diagnostic checks, deterministic hashes, local-tool separation, declared omissions and unsupported features, and visible solver/export-format TBDs without claiming external-solver validation or professional approval.

Validate the contract and review source parity, geometry/property/load/constraint and mapping coverage, coordinate/unit/provenance requirements, manifest/hash and diagnostic evidence, local FEA boundary and re-association behavior, retained tool/format TBDs, and prohibited validation or approval claims.
